Push

  • CURIE: gmeow:Push
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Push
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

The event of pushing one or more commits to a remote repository — an activity with a target repository or ref, a pusher, and a timestamp. The event type is gmeow:eventTypePush.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Activity

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Push as a specialized kind of gmeow:Activity. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Activity
